newsitem.title: FRANCE: French finance min "no comment" on GAN.
newsitem.headline: French finance min "no comment" on GAN.

text.p: The French finance ministry said on Monday it had no comment on a report in daily Le Monde that the state insurer Groupe des Assurances Nationales (GAN) could need up to 20 billion francs to prepare for privatisation.

A spokeswoman said the ministry had no comment on a report in the afternoon daily which also said that the ministry and GAN were considering a privatisation scenario involving selling 30 percent of GAN by trade sale and the rest by public share offer.
Le Monde said the scenario being considered by the ministry and GAN would involve selling off the entire property business and its CIC bank unit as well as the two-pronged sale of GAN itself.
No one at GAN was available immediately when contacted for comment.
